tools.missing: The PostgreSQL client programs were not found on the web server. Set PGADMIN_PG_BIN_DIR (config/tools.php) to their directory.
tools.no_restrict: psql {{version}} cannot run a file in restricted mode, which keeps its meta-commands from running on the web server. Use the client programs of 18, or of 17.6, 16.10, 15.14, 14.19, 13.22 or newer.

file.title: File to import:
file.compressed: File may be compressed (gzip) or uncompressed.
file.compressed_name: A compressed file's name must end in .[format].[compression]. Example: .sql.gz
file.drop: You may also drag and drop a file on this page.
file.dir_unreachable: The directory you set for upload work cannot be reached.
file.select_local: Select from the web server upload directory {{path}}:
file.no_files: There are no files to import!
file.charset_archive: An archive records the character set it was dumped in; pg_restore uses that one.
file.too_large: The file is larger than PHP accepts in an upload ({{size}}).
file.charset_binary: COPY's binary format holds no text to convert; the character set is not used.
file.charset_xml: An XML file declares its own encoding.

other.title: Other options
other.fk_checks_help: Switched off, the import runs with session_replication_role = replica, which skips foreign key checks and other triggers; it takes a superuser.

format.title: Format
format.aria: Format of the file to import

sql.single_transaction: Run the file as a single transaction (--single-transaction)

archive.creates_database: The archive's database is created on the server (--create).
archive.schema_only: Only the objects in this schema are restored (--schema).
archive.disable_triggers: Disable triggers while the data is loaded (--disable-triggers)
archive.no_data_for_failed_tables: Skip the data of tables that could not be created
archive.jobs: Number of parallel jobs (--jobs, custom archives only):
archive.set_session_authorization: Use SET SESSION AUTHORIZATION instead of ALTER OWNER
archive.table_only: Only this table and its rows are restored (--table); its indexes, constraints and triggers are not.

process.title: Importing {{file}} into {{target}}
process.finished_errors: The import of {{file}} has finished. Errors reported: {{errors}}.
process.failed_errors: The import of {{file}} failed (exit code {{code}}). Errors reported: {{errors}}.
process.lost: The import of {{file}} ended without reporting how.

copy.replace: Update data when duplicate keys found on import (add ON CONFLICT … DO UPDATE)
copy.no_primary_key: The table has no primary key for a duplicate to be found by.
copy.partial_import: Import these many number of rows (optional):
copy.columns_hint: If the data in each row of the file is not in the same order as in the table, list the corresponding column names here. Column names must be separated by commas and not enclosed in quotations. The table's order: {{columns}}
copy.ignore: Skip the rows with a value that cannot be read as its column's type (ON_ERROR ignore)
copy.col_names: The first line of the file contains the table column names (if this is unchecked, the first line will become part of the data)
copy.header_match: Check them against the column names (HEADER MATCH)
copy.null_help_csv: Empty, an unquoted empty value is NULL and a quoted one ("") an empty string.
copy.default: Text read as the column's default (DEFAULT, optional):
